2099d1c55f09: A dropdown menu for displaying choices.
bca196cb1015:
## When To Use

- A dropdown menu for displaying choices - an elegant alternative to the native `<select>` element.
- Utilizing [Radio](https://ant.design/components/radio/) is recommended when there are fewer total options (less than 5).
- You probably need [AutoComplete](https://ant.design/components/auto-complete/) if you're looking for an input box that can be typed or selected.

3f1edca1239d: Multiple selection, selecting from existing items.
787d8e089495: The height of the input field for the select defaults to 32px. If size is set to large, the height will be 40px, and if set to small, 24px.
6250fc000084: Use `optionRender` to customize the rendering dropdown options
bc7b4928cd12: Allow user to select tags from list or input custom tag.
34c1038e64c5: Coordinating the selection of provinces and cities is a common use case and demonstrates how selection can be coordinated. [Cascader](https://ant.design/components/cascader) component is strongly recommended in this case.
f9ccba0b4218:
As a default behavior, the `onChange` callback can only get the `value` of the selected item. The `labelInValue` prop can be used to get the `label` property of the selected item.

The `label` of the selected item will be packed as an object for passing to the `onChange` callback.
96f596dab320: Try to copy `Lucy,Jack` and paste to the input. Only available in tags and multiple mode.

87ab4ee377e5: Customize the dropdown menu via `popupRender`. If you want to close the dropdown after clicking the custom content, you need to control `open` prop, here is an [codesandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/ji-ben-shi-yong-antd-4-21-7-forked-gnp4cy?file=/demo.js).
6e633efce591: Hide already selected options in the dropdown.

66bd8cced46c: Allows for custom rendering of tags.
149ec13bd20f: Allows custom rendering of the currently selected label, which can be used for value backfill but the corresponding option is missing and does not want to directly render the value.
0ce708ccaf6a: Auto collapse to tag with responsive case. Not recommend use in large form case since responsive calculation has a perf cost.
69bfdb81faf3: Select use [virtual scroll](https://github.com/react-component/virtual-list) which get better performance, turn off it by setting `virtual={false}`.
25593c6beb5a: Add status to Select with `status`, which could be `error` or `warning`.
bb3fcaafd55a: You can manually specify the position of the popup via `placement`.
5b2e91384416: You can set the `maxCount` prop to control the max number of items can be selected. When the limit is exceeded, the options will become disabled.
885289c3aad9: You can customize the [semantic dom](#semantic-dom) style of Select by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
